items.item_text: Previous experience in a laboratory, technical, or operational support role (1 year or less)
Basic familiarity with laboratory environments and equipment

Maintains general laboratory organization and cleanliness. Manages laboratory waste streams, including chemical, biological, and sharps waste, in accordance with EH&S guidelines. Maintains liquid nitrogen (LN2) tanks, including monitoring levels, coordinating refills, and following safe handling procedures.
Orders laboratory supplies and consumables and maintains inventory levels Coordinates with vendors, facilities, and EH&S as needed
Assists with basic laboratory documentation and record keeping. Supports onboarding logistics for new laboratory members as needed

Covered Individuals: A Covered Individual includes anyone designated as Personnel or Students under this Policy who physically access a University Facility or Program in connection with their employment, appointment, or education/training. A person accessing a Healthcare Location as a patient, or an art, athletics, entertainment, or other publicly accessible venue at a Location as a member of the public, is not a Covered Individual.
Ability to follow written protocols and safety procedures
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
Ability to work independently on routine tasks
Clear communication skills and ability to coordinate with laboratory staff
Basic computer skills, including email and ordering systems
